title: The economics of abduction marriage: Evidence from Ethiopia
title_zh: 诱拐婚姻的经济学：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
title_primary: 诱拐婚姻的经济学：来自埃塞俄比亚的证据
title_secondary: The economics of abduction marriage: Evidence from Ethiopia
authors: Jorge García Hombrados, Lindsey Novak
official: 官方在线 2026-09-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A sizable share of marriages in several Asian and African countries are initiated by the man abducting the woman he wishes to wed. In this paper, we use quantitative and qualitative methods to characterize the practice of abduction marriage in Ethiopia. We first present the results from in-depth qualitative interviews with community leaders and abducted women in the Gambella region of Ethiopia to gain a deeper understanding of how the practice functions in these communities. These interviews suggest that abduction is typically used to overcome the refusal of the woman’s family. Second, we use Demographic and Health Survey along with ethnographic data to characterize women and ethnic groups affected by this practice in Ethiopia. Finally, we empirically examine the central hypothesis about the persistence of this practice and find evidence consistent with the hypothesis that men often use abduction to improve bargaining power in marriage negotiations and reduce the size of the bride price payment. Specifically, we demonstrate that droughts—a proxy for income shocks in this setting—increase the probability of abduction marriage only for women from ethnic groups that traditionally exchange a bride price.
abstract_zh: 在多个亚洲和非洲国家，相当比例的婚姻是由男方通过劫持其意中女子来启动的。本文运用定量与定性方法，对埃塞俄比亚的劫婚习俗进行刻画。首先，我们展示了在埃塞俄比亚甘贝拉地区对社区领袖及被劫婚女性的深度定性访谈结果，以深入理解该习俗在这些社区中的运作方式。这些访谈表明，劫婚通常用于克服女方家庭的拒绝。其次，我们利用人口健康调查数据及民族志资料，描绘了埃塞俄比亚受此习俗影响的女性及族群特征。最后，我们实证检验了关于该习俗持续存在的核心假设，并发现证据支持以下假设：男性常利用劫婚来增强婚姻谈判中的议价能力，并减少彩礼支付规模。具体而言，我们证明干旱——在此情境下作为收入冲击的代理变量——仅对传统上交换彩礼的族群中的女性增加了劫婚发生的概率。

title: Excellent boss affects subordinates’ evaluations : evidence from working full remotely
title_zh: 优秀上司影响下属评价：来自完全远程办公的证据
title_primary: 优秀上司影响下属评价：来自完全远程办公的证据
title_secondary: Excellent boss affects subordinates’ evaluations : evidence from working full remotely
authors: Hideaki Ishikura
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how supervisor–subordinate communication in a fully remote work setting affects employee salaries. We use panel data from a company where all employees work entirely remotely and exploit the company’s routine supervisor rotations as a quasi-natural experiment (in a difference-in-differences-in-differences design) to identify causal effects. Our findings show that Slack-based text communication or Zoom video meetings with one’s supervisor have little overall impact on subordinates’ salaries. However, the impact varies by supervisor ability: having frequent meetings with a supervisor significantly boosts an employee’s salary only when that supervisor is among the top 25% in performance evaluations. In contrast, text-based communication volume shows no effect. Moreover, meeting length matters – the positive impact is largest when monthly meeting time ranges between 4 and 8 hours, yielding roughly a 9.1% higher monthly salary and 21.0% greater salary increase for those subordinates compared to meeting less than 4 hours per month.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在完全远程工作环境下，上下级沟通如何影响员工薪资。我们利用一家全员远程办公公司的面板数据，并借助公司常规性的主管轮换作为准自然实验（采用三重差分设计），以识别因果效应。研究发现，通过Slack文本沟通或Zoom视频会议与主管的交流，对下属薪资整体影响甚微。然而，影响因主管能力而异：只有当主管绩效评估位列前25%时，频繁与其会面才显著提升员工薪资。相比之下，文本沟通量则无此效应。此外，会议时长亦具关键作用——当月度会议时间介于4至8小时之间时，正面影响最为显著，与月度会议不足4小时的下属相比，这些下属的月薪约高出9.1%，薪资增幅则高出21.0%。

title: The Unintended Consequences of #MeToo: Evidence from Research Collaborations in Economics and Finance
title_zh: #MeToo的意外后果：来自经济学与金融学研究合作的证据
title_primary: #MeToo的意外后果：来自经济学与金融学研究合作的证据
title_secondary: The Unintended Consequences of #MeToo: Evidence from Research Collaborations in Economics and Finance
authors: MARINA GERTSBERG
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How did #MeToo alter collaboration between women and men? I show junior female researchers start fewer projects after #MeToo. A decrease in collaborations with male coauthors—especially new senior male coauthors at the same institution—largely explains the decline. The decrease is larger at universities with higher perceived harassment accusation risk and smaller where both women and men publicly express greater awareness of gender issues. I find no evidence that reduced collaboration improves research outcomes for junior female researchers. The results suggest that #MeToo led to a breakdown in trust that came at a cost for junior women's career opportunities.
abstract_zh: #MeToo如何改变了女性与男性之间的合作？我展示了在#MeToo之后，初级女性研究员开始的项目数量减少。与男性合著者——尤其是同一机构内新晋资深男性合著者——合作的减少在很大程度上解释了这一下降趋势。在感知到骚扰指控风险较高的大学，下降幅度更大；而在女性和男性都公开表达出更高性别问题意识的大学，下降幅度则较小。我没有发现证据表明合作减少能改善初级女性研究员的研究成果。结果表明，#MeToo导致了信任的破裂，这对初级女性的职业机会造成了代价。

title: From Willingness to Engage to Demand: A Behavioral Experiment on Green Consumer Information in a Digital Product Passport
title_zh: 从参与意愿到需求：数字产品护照中绿色消费者信息的行为实验
title_primary: 从参与意愿到需求：数字产品护照中绿色消费者信息的行为实验
title_secondary: From Willingness to Engage to Demand: A Behavioral Experiment on Green Consumer Information in a Digital Product Passport
authors: Zack Dorner, Steven Tucker, Abraham Zhang, Anna Heuber
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Existing evidence shows consumers are willing to pay for labeled environmental attributes. However, there is a gap regarding whether consumers have a willingness to engage (WTE) with detailed information. The European Union’s circular economy action plan provides for a new Digital Product Passport (DPP), holding information including embedded emissions, components and materials, chemical substances, and instructions for repair, disassembly and sustainable disposal. In our theory, a green consumer decides how much to engage with information that helps them mitigate their environmental damage from consumption, given a cognitive or time cost. We test the model using a lab experiment where environmental attributes of a good are only available through a DPP. We find education on the DPP’s purpose is key to increasing revealed WTE with a DPP. This is driven by those with a lower stated WTE; participants with a high stated WTE interact with the DPP regardless. Engagement with the DPP increases knowledge and willingness to pay (WTP), as the DPP reveals favorable environmental information. We find no evidence of positive spillovers from the DPP (no further shifts in environmental orientation or increased subsequent behavior), but we find evidence that increases in WTP due to the DPP, and exposure to the DPP, lead to a negative spillover in a subsequent behavior (environmental donation). We further contribute novel measures of stated and revealed WTE, and demonstrate their value in understanding consumer behavior in a theoretically informed manner. Our study provides insights for field testing and rollout of a DPP or similar.
abstract_zh: 现有证据表明，消费者愿意为标注的环境属性支付费用。然而，关于消费者是否愿意参与（WTE）详细信息方面仍存在研究空白。欧盟循环经济行动计划规定了新的数字产品护照（DPP），其中包含嵌入排放、组件与材料、化学物质以及维修、拆解和可持续处置说明等信息。在我们的理论中，绿色消费者在面临认知或时间成本的情况下，决定投入多少精力去接触有助于减轻其消费对环境损害的信息。我们通过实验室实验检验该模型，实验中商品的环境属性仅能通过DPP获取。我们发现，对DPP目的的教育是提高揭示性WTE的关键因素，这一效应主要由那些声明WTE较低的参与者驱动；而声明WTE较高的参与者无论是否接受教育都会与DPP互动。与DPP的互动增加了知识水平和支付意愿（WTP），因为DPP揭示了有利的环境信息。我们未发现DPP存在正向溢出效应的证据（环境取向无进一步转变或后续行为无增加），但发现DPP导致的WTP增加以及接触DPP，会在后续行为（环境捐赠）中产生负向溢出效应。我们进一步贡献了声明性和揭示性WTE的新颖测量方法，并展示了其在理论指导下理解消费者行为方面的价值。我们的研究为DPP或类似机制的实地测试和推广提供了见解。

title: Timetables, attendance and academic achievement in higher education
title_zh: 高等教育中的课程表、出勤率与学业成绩
title_primary: 高等教育中的课程表、出勤率与学业成绩
title_secondary: Timetables, attendance and academic achievement in higher education
authors: Adeline Delavande, Emilia Del Bono, Angus Holford, Kevin Williams
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Managing time is an important aspect of student success. In this paper, we identify the impacts of a student’s timetable on their attendance, study habits, and academic achievement. We use detailed administrative and survey data from a public UK university that includes students from a broad range of degree programmes. Our data feature quasi-random assignment of students to their timetables and measure their individual hourly attendance decisions. We consider multiple aspects of timetables including single-class days, back-to-back classes, time-of-day, day-of-instruction and total hours. We find that student attendance is highly dependent on timetable structure. Single-class days reduce attendance and back-to-back classes raise it. Attendance also varies by time-of-day and day-of-week. We document that students compensate for marginal non-attendance at some events with increased attendance at others within the same module and that more conscientious students respond by increasing study time. Net of all behavioural responses, however, these timetable features and attendance choices do not have systematic impacts on academic achievement. Subsample analysis suggests that lab-based modules and compulsory modules are where timetables may play the most meaningful role in impacting marks.
abstract_zh: 时间管理是学生成功的重要方面。本文旨在识别学生课程表对其出勤、学习习惯及学业成绩的影响。我们利用来自英国一所公立大学的详细行政与调查数据，该数据涵盖广泛学位课程的学生。我们的数据特点在于学生课程表的准随机分配，并测量了学生每小时的出勤决策。我们考察了课程表的多个方面，包括单日单课、连续课程、上课时段、教学日及总课时。研究发现，学生出勤高度依赖于课程表结构。单日单课降低了出勤率，而连续课程则提高了出勤率。出勤情况亦随上课时段和星期几而变化。我们记录到，学生会在同一模块内以增加其他活动出勤的方式，来补偿对某些活动的边际缺勤，且更为认真的学生会通过增加学习时间作为回应。然而，在考虑所有行为反应后，这些课程表特征及出勤选择并未对学业成绩产生系统性影响。子样本分析表明，实验室模块和必修模块是课程表可能对成绩产生最显著影响的领域。

title: Blood and Iron: Political Fragmentation in the Ancient Eastern Mediterranean
title_zh: 血与铁：古代东地中海的政治分裂
title_primary: 血与铁：古代东地中海的政治分裂
title_secondary: Blood and Iron: Political Fragmentation in the Ancient Eastern Mediterranean
authors: Patrick Fitzsimmons
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines how the transition to iron metallurgy lowered the cost of organised violence and drove political fragmentation across the Eastern Mediterranean after 1200 BCE. Bronze required scarce inputs, concentrating coercive capacity among elites. Iron was widely abundant, redistributing access to weapons beyond the elite class and undermining centralised control. Using novel geospatial data of ancient polities, I exploit staggered iron adoption across 200 km × 200 km grid-cells in a Two-Way Fixed Effects framework. Iron adoption increases polities per cell by 1.356 to 1.521 units. The results are robust to a variety of alternative specifications and competing explanations.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了铁冶金技术的转型如何降低了有组织暴力的成本，并在公元前1200年之后推动了东地中海地区的政治分裂。青铜需要稀缺的原料，将强制力集中在精英阶层手中。而铁资源广泛丰富，使得武器获取途径重新分配，超越了精英阶层，削弱了中央集权控制。利用古代政体的新型地理空间数据，我在200公里×200公里的网格单元中，采用双向固定效应模型，利用铁器采用的阶段性差异进行分析。铁器的采用使每个网格单元中的政体数量增加了1.356至1.521个。这一结果在多种替代规格和竞争性解释下依然稳健。

title: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
title_zh: 学校中断对父母劳动力供给的影响：来自加拿大面板数据的证据
title_primary: 学校中断对父母劳动力供给的影响：来自加拿大面板数据的证据
title_secondary: The Effect of School Disruptions on Parental Labor Supply: Evidence from Canadian Panel Data
authors: Dean R. Lillard, Joseph J. Sabia, Zihao Sheng, Casey Warman
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This study explores the effects of COVID-19 school closures on labor market outcomes of Canadian parents of school-aged children. Using newly collected data on grade-level-specific school closures across 141 Canadian cities along with individual-level panel data from the Labour Force Survey, difference-in-differences estimates provide robust evidence that restrictions on in-person schooling reduced employment among partnered mothers of school-aged children by approximately 2 percentage points. For fathers, labor supply adjustments are much weaker and concentrated on single fathers. Finally, auxiliary analyses using administrative tax records provide suggestive evidence that school closures increased public benefit receipt among single parents.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了COVID-19学校关闭对加拿大有学龄儿童父母劳动力市场结果的影响。利用新收集的覆盖141个加拿大城市的分年级学校关闭数据，以及来自劳动力调查的个体层面面板数据，双重差分估计提供了稳健证据，表明面对面教学限制使有学龄儿童的已婚母亲就业率下降了约2个百分点。对于父亲而言，劳动力供给调整较弱，且主要集中在单亲父亲群体。最后，利用行政税务记录的辅助分析提供了提示性证据，表明学校关闭增加了单亲父母领取公共福利的情况。

title: From Shadow AI to Governed AI Review: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
title_zh: 从影子人工智能到受治理的人工智能评审：对“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量”的评论
title_primary: 从影子人工智能到受治理的人工智能评审：对“以火攻火：将人工智能融入同行评审以维持学术质量”的评论
title_secondary: From Shadow AI to Governed AI Review: A Commentary on “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship”
authors: Zhenhui (Jack) Jiang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This commentary responds to “Fighting Fire with Fire: Infusing AI into Peer Review to Sustain Quality Scholarship” [Bhargava et al. (2026) Management Sci. Forthcoming.]. It supports the paper’s call for a governed approach to the use of AI in peer review. It argues that the key issue is not whether AI will enter peer review, but whether its use will remain informal and hidden or become transparent, auditable, and institutionally accountable. While endorsing journal-managed AI review as a response to the problem of “shadow AI,” the comment highlights several implementation risks, including AI hallucination, human accountability, authors’ perceptions of procedural dignity, and the evolving boundary between structured assessment and value judgment. It concludes that AI-assisted peer review should be treated as an important starting point for continued experimentation and refinement. This commentary was accepted by Christoph Loch.
abstract_zh: 本评论回应了“以火攻火：将人工智能注入同行评审以维持学术质量”一文[Bhargava等（2026）《管理科学》，即将发表]。评论支持该文关于在同行评审中采用受治理方式使用人工智能的呼吁，并指出关键问题并非人工智能是否会介入同行评审，而是其使用将保持非正式且隐蔽，还是变得透明、可审计且具有机构问责性。在赞同期刊管理式人工智能评审作为应对“影子人工智能”问题的同时，本评论强调了若干实施风险，包括人工智能幻觉、人类问责、作者对程序尊严的感知，以及结构化评估与价值判断之间不断演变的界限。评论最后指出，人工智能辅助同行评审应被视为持续实验与改进的重要起点。本评论由克里斯托夫·洛赫接受。

title: Landmines and Spatial Development
title_zh: 地雷与空间发展
title_primary: 地雷与空间发展
title_secondary: Landmines and Spatial Development
authors: Giorgio Chiovelli, Stelios Michalopoulos, Elias Papaioannou, Ufuk Akcigit, Furkan Kilic 等
official: 官方在线 2018-06-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: this study, we explore the economic consequences of landmine clearance in Mozambique, the only country that has moved from "heavily-contaminated" in 1992 to "mine-free" status in 2015. First, we compile a dataset detailing the evolution of clearance, collecting thousands of reports from the numerous demining actors. Second, we exploit the timing of demining to assess its impact on local economic activity, as reflected in satellite images of light density at night. The analysis reveals a moderate positive association that masks sizeable heterogeneity. Economic activity responds strongly to clearance of the transportation network, trade hubs, and more populous areas, while the demining-development association is weak in rural areas of low population density. Third, recognizing that landmine removal recon˝figured the accessibility to the transportation infrastructure, we apply a "market-access" approach to quantify both its direct and indirect effects. The market-access estimates reveal substantial improvements on aggregate economic activity. The market-access benefits of demining are also present in localities without any contamination. Fourth, counterfactual policy simulations project considerable gains had the fragmented process of clearance in Mozambique been centrally coordinated, prioritizing clearance of the colonial transportation routes.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了莫桑比克排雷行动的经济后果，该国是唯一一个从1992年的“重度污染”状态转变为2015年“无雷”状态的国家。首先，我们编制了一个详细记录排雷进展的数据集，收集了众多排雷行动方数千份报告。其次，我们利用排雷的时间节点来评估其对当地经济活动的影响，这通过卫星图像中的夜间灯光密度得以反映。分析显示，存在一种适度的正向关联，但掩盖了显著的异质性。经济活动对交通网络、贸易枢纽及人口更稠密地区的排雷反应强烈，而在人口密度较低的农村地区，排雷与发展的关联则较弱。第三，鉴于地雷清除重新配置了交通基础设施的可达性，我们采用“市场准入”方法量化其直接与间接效应。市场准入估计显示，总体经济活动有显著改善。排雷的市场准入效益也惠及无污染地区。第四，反事实政策模拟预测，若莫桑比克碎片化的排雷过程曾由中央协调，优先清除殖民时期的交通路线，将带来可观收益。

title: Are short sellers lured by analyst consensus?
title_zh: 做空者会被分析师共识吸引吗？
title_primary: 做空者会被分析师共识吸引吗？
title_secondary: Are short sellers lured by analyst consensus?
authors: Harold Contreras, Francisco Marcet
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate whether short sellers process a specific type of public information: heterogeneity in analysts’ individual EPS forecasts. We find that short-selling activity increases after earnings announcements when firms miss the key analyst forecast beyond missing the analyst consensus forecast. Moreover, higher short-selling activity following key analyst forecast misses predicts lower subsequent returns, consistent with profitable trading. A quasi-experimental design based on exogenous reductions in key analyst coverage further supports our interpretation. Overall, our results highlight a specific channel through which short sellers obtain an informational advantage and improve our understanding of the public signals they process.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了卖空者是否处理一种特定类型的公开信息：分析师个人每股收益预测的异质性。研究发现，当公司未达到关键分析师预测（而非仅未达到分析师共识预测）时，盈余公告后的卖空活动会增加。此外，关键分析师预测未达标后更高的卖空活动预示着后续较低的回报，这与盈利交易相符。基于关键分析师覆盖外生减少的准实验设计进一步支持了我们的解释。总体而言，我们的结果突显了卖空者获取信息优势的一个具体渠道，并增进了对其所处理公开信号的理解。

abstract: We show that the global human capital increase during the 20th-century contributed to structural transformation. We document that almost half of the decline in aggregate agricultural employment was driven by new birth cohorts entering the labor market. We use data on educational attainment and compile a comprehensive list of policy reforms to interpret the differences in agricultural employment across cohorts. We find that the increase in schooling led to a sharp reduction in the agricultural labor supply by equipping younger cohorts with skills more valued out of agriculture. Interpreted through an equilibrium model of frictional labor reallocation, these facts imply that human capital growth accounts for about 20% of the global decline in agricultural employment.

abstract: 在数智时代，数智技术渗透与数据价值激活使企业间竞合日益普遍，且更具价值创造潜力。然而现有竞合理论囿于人类决策主体性、传统资源稀缺性、组织边界稳定性的隐含假设，难以解释以人机协同为决策主体、以数据为核心资源、以平台生态为主要场域的竞合新现实。本文通过系统性文献综述，梳理竞合理论从概念溯源、视角拓展到体系整合的演进脉络，揭示传统理论范式的解释边界。在系统总结数智时代企业间竞合实践呈现的悖论性加剧、动态性增强、价值性提升等新趋势，以及分析竞合研究向数智化转型、数字平台生态系统等情境拓展的基础上，本文提出“数智竞合”概念，构建了整合“微观—中观—宏观”层次与“前因—过程—结果”链条的矩阵式研究框架。具体而言，本文在微观层面聚焦人机协同决策中的数智认知与算法特征、信任互动与能力演化等；中观层面探讨数智化组织变革、组织间数智链接、数实融合与算法赋能的演化和治理过程等；宏观层面分析数智经济环境与平台生态情境、多主体复杂网络演化与平台元治理以及生态绩效等价值结果。本文不仅有助于研究者加深对竞合理论演进和发展的理解，还通过提出数智竞合概念及研究展望，为根植于中国数智化实践的竞合研究提供新视角。

title: When contracts interact: Land rental portfolios and farm productivity in Tigray, north Ethiopia
title_zh: 合同互动：埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区的土地租赁组合与农业生产率
title_primary: 合同互动：埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区的土地租赁组合与农业生产率
title_secondary: When contracts interact: Land rental portfolios and farm productivity in Tigray, north Ethiopia
authors: Tafesse W. Gezahegn, Tewodros Tadesse, Bouali Guesmi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Land rental markets play a central role in reallocating land toward more productive farmers in developing countries. Yet empirical evidence often overlooks the co-adoption of multiple contract types by farmers. This paper examines the productivity implications of individual and combined land rental contracts using farm-level data from Tigray, north Ethiopia. We model the productivity-effects of contract combinations using a Multinomial Endogenous Treatment Effects model that corrects for self-selection on unobservables, and a copula-based binary endogenous selection model allowing for flexible dependence between unobserved determinants of rental participation and productivity. Results reveal substantial endogenous selection into rental contracts and pronounced heterogeneity across contractual arrangements. Fixed-rent contracts—whether adopted alone or in mixed portfolios—consistently enhance productivity after correcting for selection. In contrast, sharecropping tends to reduce productivity, particularly when combined with own cultivation or fixed-rental, suggesting offsetting incentive effects within mixed contract portfolios. Copula-based estimates confirm that rental participation is productivity-enhancing on average and are robust across Gaussian and Frank specifications. Taken together, the findings highlight the importance of contract interaction. Policies promoting land rental markets should therefore focus not only on expanding access but also on fostering incentive-compatible contractual arrangements that support productive land use.
abstract_zh: 土地租赁市场在发展中国家将土地重新配置给更具生产力的农民方面发挥着核心作用。然而，实证研究往往忽视了农民同时采用多种合同类型的情况。本文利用埃塞俄比亚北部提格雷地区的农户层面数据，考察了单独及组合土地租赁合同的生产力影响。我们采用多项式内生处理效应模型来模拟合同组合的生产力效应，该模型纠正了不可观测因素导致的自选择问题，并运用基于copula的二元内生选择模型，允许租赁参与和生产力之间不可观测决定因素存在灵活的相关性。研究结果显示，租赁合同存在显著的内生选择，且不同合同安排之间存在明显的异质性。固定租金合同——无论是单独采用还是作为混合组合的一部分——在纠正选择偏差后均能持续提升生产力。相比之下，分成制往往降低生产力，尤其是当与自有耕作或固定租金合同结合时，这表明混合合同组合中存在抵消性的激励效应。基于copula的估计证实，租赁参与平均而言能提升生产力，且在高斯和弗兰克设定下均保持稳健。综合来看，研究结果强调了合同互动的重要性。因此，促进土地租赁市场的政策不仅应着眼于扩大准入，还应致力于培育支持生产性土地利用的激励相容合同安排。

title: Balancing growth and conservation: Land-use policy scenarios for Uruguay’s grasslands
title_zh: 平衡增长与保护：乌拉圭草原土地利用政策情景
title_primary: 平衡增长与保护：乌拉圭草原土地利用政策情景
title_secondary: Balancing growth and conservation: Land-use policy scenarios for Uruguay’s grasslands
authors: Melanie Schweikart, Leonardo R. Ramírez, Ina Säumel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Land-use scenario simulations support policy decisions that seek to balance economic development with environmental conservation. In Uruguay’s Río de la Plata temperate grasslands, agribusiness expansion has driven land-use intensification, threatening biodiversity, ecosystem services, and rural livelihoods. This study integrates land-use data from 2000 to 2015 with explanatory variables in a multi-layer perceptron Markov model to predict vulnerability to change and land-use patterns for 2030 under three scenarios: business-as-usual, multifunctional land use, and grassland conservation. Under continued intensification, native grasslands are predicted to decline by 9% to a land cover of 51% by 2030, with cropland expansion accounting for 80% of the loss. Reducing cropland expansion and maintaining timber plantations at 2015 levels could preserve grassland cover at 57%, corresponding to more than 10,000 km² compared to the business-as-usual scenario. Except for a northern area with comparatively low conflict potential, approximately two-thirds of Uruguay remain highly susceptible to agricultural conversion. Applying 90 m and 180 m conservation buffers around sensitive areas may reduce agricultural spillover and enhance ecosystem service provision. Implementing 90 m protection buffers substantially curtails cropland expansion within designated areas, resulting in a 139% relative difference in net cropland change compared to the business as usual scenario. By providing high-resolution vulnerability assessments and policy-relevant insights, this study supports evidence-based land-use planning and highlights how targeted conservation measures can help navigate trade-offs between agricultural development and ecological resilience at national and local scales.
abstract_zh: 土地利用情景模拟为寻求平衡经济发展与环境保护的政策决策提供支持。在乌拉圭拉普拉塔河流域的温带草原地区，农业综合企业的扩张推动了土地利用集约化，威胁到生物多样性、生态系统服务和农村生计。本研究整合2000年至2015年的土地利用数据与解释变量，采用多层感知器马尔可夫模型，预测三种情景下（常规发展、多功能土地利用和草原保护）2030年的变化脆弱性及土地利用格局。在持续集约化情景下，预计原生草原面积将减少9%，至2030年土地覆盖率降至51%，其中耕地扩张占损失的80%。减少耕地扩张并将人工林维持在2015年水平，可将草原覆盖率保持在57%，与常规发展情景相比，相当于保留超过10,000平方公里的草原面积。除北部一个冲突潜力相对较低的区域外，乌拉圭约三分之二的国土仍高度易受农业转化影响。在敏感区域周围设置90米和180米的保护缓冲带，可减少农业溢出效应并增强生态系统服务供给。实施90米保护缓冲带可大幅遏制指定区域内的耕地扩张，与常规发展情景相比，耕地净变化相对差异达139%。通过提供高分辨率脆弱性评估和政策相关洞见，本研究为基于证据的土地利用规划提供支持，并凸显了有针对性的保护措施如何在国家和地方尺度上协调农业发展与环境韧性之间的权衡。

title: Class Discipline, Class Size and Scholastic Achievement Across Countries: A Theoretical and Empirical View of Educational Production

authors: Noam Gruber
official: 官方在线 2026-05-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Formulating an education production function and using estimates of student and class discipline levels, this paper seeks to identify the relations between discipline, class size, teaching quality and scholastic outcomes. The data shows both individual and class-level discipline to be a powerful predictor of the PISA math score, while variance in discipline among classmates has a strongly negative effect. Furthermore, class discipline is correlated with larger classes. As a structural simulation demonstrates, the correlations observed in the data can be well explained by how schools allocate students and teachers to classes. This analysis allows for a break-down of the contribution of educational production factors and highlights the role of individual and class discipline to student achievements.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建教育生产函数，并利用学生与班级纪律水平的估计值，旨在识别纪律、班级规模、教学质量与学业成果之间的关系。数据显示，个体及班级层面的纪律水平对PISA数学成绩具有显著预测力，而同学间纪律水平的差异则产生强烈的负面效应。此外，班级纪律与较大班级规模存在相关性。结构模拟表明，数据中观察到的相关性可通过学校如何将学生与教师分配至班级得到合理解释。该分析能够分解教育生产因素的贡献，并凸显个体与班级纪律对学生学业成就的重要作用。

title: One Global Shock, Many Inflation Paths: Explaining Post-COVID Inflation Divergence
title_zh: 一次全球冲击，多种通胀路径：解释后疫情时代的通胀分化
title_primary: 一次全球冲击，多种通胀路径：解释后疫情时代的通胀分化
title_secondary: One Global Shock, Many Inflation Paths: Explaining Post-COVID Inflation Divergence
authors: Patrick A. Imam & Mr. Tigran Poghosyan
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates why the post-COVID inflation surge, though globally synchronized, led to widely divergent outcomes across countries. Using cross-country regressions for 130 economies and local projections methods for 70 advanced and emerging markets, we analyze the structural, institutional, and policy determinants of post-pandemic inflation dynamics. The results indicate that historical inflation and the scale of domestic energy price shocks account for most of the cross-country variation in cumulative post-COVID inflation. In contrast, many frequently cited country-specific, macroeconomic fundamentals and institutional features exhibit limited power to explain cross-country variation. The association between post-COVID inflation and domestic policy responses is also weak, although endogeneity complicates a clear causal interpretation. The analysis further reveals that pass-through from energy prices to headline inflation intensified markedly in the post-COVID period, particularly in emerging markets, in non-inflation-targeting regimes, and in countries that did not expand fossil fuel subsidies. These findings highlight the asymmetric transmission of supply shocks and underscore the importance of credibility, historical inflation experience, and energy policy design in shaping inflation persistence. Strengthening central bank credibility and anchoring expectations may be essential to bolster resilience against future global supply disruptions.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了为何新冠疫情后的通胀飙升虽具有全球同步性，却在各国间产生了截然不同的结果。基于对130个经济体的跨国回归分析以及对70个发达和新兴市场的局部投影方法研究，我们剖析了疫情后通胀动态的结构性、制度性及政策决定因素。结果表明，历史通胀水平与国内能源价格冲击的规模解释了新冠疫情后累计通胀的大部分跨国差异。相比之下，许多常被引用的国别特定因素、宏观经济基本面及制度特征在解释跨国差异方面能力有限。新冠疫情后通胀与国内政策响应之间的关联也较弱，尽管内生性问题使因果关系的清晰解读变得复杂。分析进一步揭示，疫情后能源价格向整体通胀的传导效应显著增强，尤其在新兴市场、非通胀目标制国家以及未扩大化石燃料补贴的经济体中。这些发现凸显了供给冲击的非对称传导机制，并强调了可信度、历史通胀经验及能源政策设计在塑造通胀持续性中的关键作用。加强央行可信度并锚定通胀预期，对于增强抵御未来全球供给中断的韧性至关重要。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the significance of including a company's location of origin in its name, a practice known as using an eponymous location name. Our theory demonstrates that signalling an origin from a prestigious location is an appealing strategy for relatively weaker companies, whereas stronger companies tend to avoid it. We empirically test this theory on a sample of UK university spin‐outs from 2010 to 2021. Eponymous location names are particularly prevalent among spin‐outs from Oxbridge (i.e., Oxford and Cambridge). As predicted by our theory, eponymous location names are negatively related to measures of fundraising success after controlling for spin‐out origin.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将公司原产地名称纳入公司名称（即使用同名地名）的重要意义。我们的理论表明，对于相对较弱的公司而言，通过名称彰显其源自知名地区是一种具有吸引力的策略，而实力较强的公司则倾向于避免这种做法。我们以2010年至2021年间英国大学衍生企业为样本，对该理论进行了实证检验。同名地名在牛津剑桥（即牛津大学和剑桥大学）的衍生企业中尤为普遍。正如理论所预测，在控制衍生企业原产地因素后，同名地名与融资成功指标呈负相关关系。

title: Mixing It Up: Inflation at Risk
title_zh: 混合因素：风险中的通胀

authors: MAXIMILIAN SCHRÖDER
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-05-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Understanding how risk factors shape the economic outlook is essential for guiding policy decisions. This paper develops a flexible framework that decomposes distributional risk forecasts of macro‐economic variables into underlying contributions and supports the construction of interpretable risk measures. Multiple modeling strategies, including density and quantile regression, are accommodated underscoring the versatility of the approach. The framework is illustrated using recent U.S. inflation data, showing postpandemic risk forecasts were driven by the business cycle, commodity prices, monetary policy, and inflation expectations. Simulation studies demonstrate robustness, establishing the framework as a general tool for macro‐economic and financial risk assessment.
abstract_zh: 理解风险因素如何塑造经济前景对于指导政策决策至关重要。本文构建了一个灵活的分析框架，将宏观经济变量的分布风险预测分解为潜在贡献因素，并支持构建可解释的风险度量指标。该框架兼容密度回归与分位数回归等多种建模策略，凸显其方法论的普适性。通过近期美国通胀数据的实证分析表明，后疫情时期的风险预测主要受商业周期、大宗商品价格、货币政策及通胀预期驱动。模拟研究验证了框架的稳健性，确立了其作为宏观经济与金融风险评估通用工具的地位。

abstract: This paper examines how consumption taxes—through the taxation of input goods—can affect firms’ product mix decisions. We study India’s staggered transition from a sales tax, where there was the risk that intermediate inputs are taxed multiple times along the supply chain, to a value-added tax (VAT) that offered credits for taxes paid on inputs. Using detailed product-level data for manufacturing firms and a stacked difference-in-differences design, we find that firms respond to the VAT adoption by narrowing their product scope through reducing vertical integration. These changes reflect a shift away from internal production of inputs, which was tax-induced under the sales tax system, toward greater specialization in the most profitable outputs. We also document that this vertical disintegration leads to lower manufacturing costs, greater profitability, improved investment efficiency, and higher firm value. Our findings highlight how consumption tax design can affect resource allocation within firms and that reducing tax burdens on input goods enhances operational efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了消费税——通过对投入品征税——如何影响企业的产品组合决策。我们研究了印度从销售税（在该税制下，中间投入品沿供应链存在多次被征税的风险）向增值税（VAT）的渐进式过渡，后者对投入品已缴税款提供抵扣。利用制造业企业详细的产品层面数据以及堆叠双重差分设计，我们发现企业通过减少纵向一体化来应对增值税的采纳，从而收窄其产品范围。这些变化反映了从销售税制度下因税收诱因而进行的内部投入品生产，转向对最具盈利能力的产出进行更大程度专业化的转变。我们还记录了这种纵向解体导致制造成本降低、盈利能力增强、投资效率提升以及企业价值提高。我们的研究结果凸显了消费税设计如何影响企业内部资源配置，并表明减轻投入品税收负担能够提升运营效率。

title: The macroeconomics of automation
title_zh: 自动化的宏观经济学
title_primary: 自动化的宏观经济学
title_secondary: The macroeconomics of automation
authors: Hideki Nakamura, Masakatsu Nakamura, Shota Moriwaki
official: 官方在线 2026-03-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a theory in which the degree of automation in the aggregate economy emerges endogenously as an equilibrium outcome and can be inferred from standard macroeconomic data. We define the degree of automation as the share of tasks performed by capital rather than labor and embed it in a task-based production framework with endogenous technology adoption. Aggregating task-level decisions generates a CES production function in which the economy-wide degree of automation emerges endogenously. This structure provides a transparent mapping from standard macroeconomic observables, such as the capital-labor ratio, output per worker, and the elasticity of substitution, into the degree of automation, allowing automation to be measured without relying on technology-specific indicators. Applying the framework to Japanese manufacturing industries, we show that automation increased through capital deepening even during periods of slow productivity growth. abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，其中经济总体自动化程度作为均衡结果内生形成，并可通过标准宏观经济数据推断得出。我们将自动化程度定义为资本而非劳动执行的任务份额，并将其嵌入一个包含内生技术采纳的任务型生产框架中。通过加总任务层面的决策，我们推导出包含内生经济总体自动化程度的CES生产函数。该结构建立了从标准宏观经济可观测变量（如资本劳动比、人均产出和替代弹性）到自动化程度的透明映射关系，使得无需依赖特定技术指标即可衡量自动化水平。将该框架应用于日本制造业部门后，我们发现即使在生产率增长缓慢时期，自动化仍通过资本深化过程持续提升。

title: Does the stepping‐stone effect of temporary agency employment vary over the business cycle?
title_zh: 临时派遣就业的阶梯效应是否随经济周期变化？
title_primary: 临时派遣就业的阶梯效应是否随经济周期变化？
title_secondary: Does the stepping‐stone effect of temporary agency employment vary over the business cycle?
authors: Elke J. Jahn, Michael Rosholm
official: 官方在线 2026-01-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the cyclicality of the stepping-stone effect of temporary agency work in Germany across three business cycles using administrative data and a timing-of-events model. We estimate in- and post-treatment effects and their response to the unemployment rate. We find a strong lock-in effect of agency employment, particularly in tight labor markets, suggesting that firms rarely use agency work for screening. The positive post-treatment effect is larger in downturns, indicating that workers activate the networks built during agency jobs. The matching quality improves for those transitioning directly into regular employment, with greater gains in upturns.
abstract_zh: 我们利用行政数据和事件时间模型，考察了德国三个商业周期中临时机构工作的垫脚石效应的周期性。我们估计了处理期间及处理后的效应及其对失业率的响应。我们发现机构就业存在强烈的锁定效应，尤其在劳动力市场紧张时更为显著，这表明企业很少利用机构工作进行筛选。处理后的正向效应在经济下行期更大，表明工人激活了在机构工作期间建立的网络。直接过渡到正规就业者的匹配质量有所提升，且在经济上行期收益更大。

title: Endogenous partial cross-ownership in network industries
title_zh: 网络产业中的内生性部分交叉所有权
title_primary: 网络产业中的内生性部分交叉所有权
title_secondary: Endogenous partial cross-ownership in network industries
authors: Domenico Buccella, Luciano Fanti, Luca Gori
official: 官方在线 2025-11-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we revisit the classical question of how partial passive cross-ownership (PPCO) influences competition in network industries. Contrary to conventional wisdom, our findings reveal that PPCO benefits firms only when ownership shares are of limited size, and in some cases, it may reduce profitability. These unconventional results are more likely to hold with higher network externality intensity and lower product compatibility. The work characterises the conditions on the model’s parameters and provides empirical and policy implications. Similar content being viewed by others
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了部分被动交叉持股（PPCO）如何影响网络产业竞争这一经典问题。与传统认知相反，我们的研究发现，只有当持股比例有限时，PPCO才能为企业带来收益，在某些情况下甚至可能降低盈利能力。这些非传统结果在网络外部性强度更高、产品兼容性更低时更可能出现。本研究刻画了模型参数的条件，并提供了实证与政策启示。

title: COVID-19, Crises, and Women’s Control of Resources: Evidence from Mexico
title_zh: COVID-19、危机与女性资源控制：来自墨西哥的证据
title_primary: COVID-19、危机与女性资源控制：来自墨西哥的证据
title_secondary: COVID-19, Crises, and Women’s Control of Resources: Evidence from Mexico
authors: José L. Casco
official: 官方在线 2025-08-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the relationship between crises and the intrahousehold allocation of resources. Using data from Mexico, I estimate a structural collective model to identify the distribution of household resources among its members. Then, I construct a proxy for women’s bargaining power on the basis of their control of resources and document how it evolves over periods of economic stability and contraction. The results indicate that during the COVID-19 crisis, women’s control over household resources declined by approximately 4–5 percentage points compared with non-recession periods and by 6–8 percentage points relative to the financial crisis, with a more pronounced effect for households with children. I further analyze how this resource reallocation affects individual poverty. The findings highlight the heterogeneous behavior of intrahousehold inequality over the business cycle. They also suggest that the hypothesis that the financial crisis was a “man-cession” and the COVID-19 crisis was a “she-cession” holds in terms of intrahousehold resource allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了危机与家庭内部资源配置之间的关系。利用墨西哥的数据，我估计了一个结构性集体模型，以识别家庭成员间资源的分配情况。随后，我基于女性对资源的控制构建了一个衡量其议价能力的代理指标，并记录了该指标在经济稳定期与收缩期的演变过程。结果表明，在COVID-19危机期间，女性对家庭资源的控制相比非衰退时期下降了约4至5个百分点，相比金融危机时期下降了6至8个百分点，且对有子女的家庭影响更为显著。我进一步分析了这种资源重新配置对个体贫困的影响。研究结果凸显了家庭内部不平等在经济周期中的异质性表现，同时也表明，关于金融危机为“男性衰退”和COVID-19危机为“女性衰退”的假设，在家庭内部资源配置方面得到了证实。

title: Cross-ownership, R&D decision, and social welfare in a duopoly
title_zh: 双寡头市场中的交叉持股、研发决策与社会福利
title_primary: 双寡头市场中的交叉持股、研发决策与社会福利
title_secondary: Cross-ownership, R&D decision, and social welfare in a duopoly
authors: Junlong Chen, Zuli Han, Jiali Liu
official: 官方在线 2025-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study constructs an R&D technology model that considers cross-ownership (CO) in a duopoly, analyses the boundaries of R&D decisions, and examines the impacts of CO on R&D efforts and social welfare. Our findings reveal that an increase in CO level negatively affects social welfare, while both independent and collaborative R&D can enhance social welfare. In independent R&D, it is crucial to control CO levels, as excessive CO can result in a monopoly, leading to a significant loss of social welfare. The impact of CO on R&D effort is dual, with the outcome hinging on the contrast between the ‘prospect-improving effect’ of R&D and the ‘competition-softening effect’ induced by CO. The extended analysis finds that reverse shareholding, in which a non-R&D firm holds equity in an R&D firm, exacerbates the asymmetry in the cost-benefit distribution structure, hindering collaborative R&D and reducing R&D efforts. In the context of CO, allocating decision-making power based on equity shares is a more effective strategy for enhancing social welfare and improving R&D performance.
abstract_zh: 本研究构建了一个考虑交叉持股（CO）的双寡头研发技术模型，分析了研发决策的边界，并考察了交叉持股对研发努力和社会福利的影响。研究发现，交叉持股水平的提升对社会福利产生负面影响，而独立研发与合作研发均能增进社会福利。在独立研发情形下，控制交叉持股水平至关重要，因为过高的交叉持股可能导致垄断，从而造成社会福利的重大损失。交叉持股对研发努力的影响具有双重性，其结果取决于研发的“前景改善效应”与交叉持股引发的“竞争缓和效应”之间的对比。扩展分析发现，反向持股——即非研发企业对研发企业持有股权——加剧了成本收益分配结构的不对称性，阻碍了合作研发并降低了研发努力。在交叉持股背景下，基于股权份额分配决策权是提升社会福利和改善研发绩效的更有效策略。
